name: web/ThinkPHP invokefunction controller RCE
description: [critical] GOD TIER — ThinkPHP 5.x invokefunction RCE (CVE-2018-25270, ExploitDB 45978, actively exploited): the router accepts \think\app as a controller and invokefunction as an action, so call_user_func_array('phpinfo') renders the phpinfo page = arbitrary function call -> getshell. Keywords: thinkphp invokefunction rce call_user_func_array phpinfo cve-2018-25270 exploitdb 45978. ctrl: patched routing answers 404 -> not falsified. base_url = ThinkPHP app root.
